blocks.text: NOTE: Study the writings carefully and God will reveal many things to you.
Rev. 10:2 – And he had a little Book “scrolls” in his hand. And when he had Cried 7 thunders uttered their voices!
Rev. 10:3 – And he had in his right Hand 7 stars.
Rev. 1:16-19 – He said write the things Which thou has seen.
“BEHOLD I COME QUICKLY! TIME IS SHORT. GET READY.”
This book contains recorded sermon messages preached by our beloved Brother Neal Frisby for our personal perusal - Selah!

The reader is admonished to study this translation alert properly. Do not take it lightly but reason within your heart, because some incredible and exciting things are there for you (The Bride Elect).

By studying often, this translation alert will create a spectacular and dramatic inner feeling of a high spiritual atmosphere and complete confidence with understanding and change will come into your life leaving you a mighty spiritual uplift. “Truly I have spoken it saith the Lord”.
“Thus saith the Lord Jesus, I have chosen this path and have called those who are to walk there in it, these will be those who follow me wherever I goeth”- (see SW 86)
Our prayer is that, may the Lord bless and keep your eyes open to cherish the hidden things in this message. Amen.
